# Pulse task #2792: Carry live track-gain previews through verified-streaming playback

Operation: ac017bf5c6244e51a7dbc15f348f738b
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Focused remaining integration under track-header volume Pulse2715/PR331, discovered by read-only Astra source audit of ff00d67ced69d20d394db686cc179b827d0a394b (same relevant04e6 path). Duplicate live searches 'streaming preview'/'TrackGain' found none; 'verified streaming' returned broad2679 and conversion2658, neither this gesture source boundary. Resident is normal startup/New/Open, but DocumentAudioMode::VerifiedStreaming is a real explicit New/Open menu option (menus24–32/render697–708/dialogs102–152), not test/export-only.

Existing coalesced gesture prepared-preview supports Resident. Verified mode deliberately emits playback=None (service2903), preview ViewState cannot mint canonical freshness, WorkerEvents::send forwards only changed canonical source (audio_sink88–95), NativeAudioSink canonical_changed drives verified preparation. Extending GestureTarget::TrackGain alone therefore does not make held dragging audible in this supported optional document mode. Do not claim complete2715 coverage or silently substitute release-only behavior.

Goal: a narrowly typed, actual correlated transient gesture-source path through existing WorkerEvents→WorkerAudioSink→NativeAudioSink verified preparation/publication. Bind actual canonical base, worker/request generation, TrackId, actual gesture key+sequence and terminal/cancel state. No relabelled preview Project as canonical, arbitrary frontend context/flags, resident fallback, rawArc owner adoption/new cache/provider/owner family, gain-recording misuse or ratio multiplier (zero-start must work). Reuse existing verified source reservation/read/ownership/admission; source4 coordination required around real worker/source freshness and public preparation contracts. Preserve pending/current original-resource bank design in2783/2789; do not open Sampler/native resource admission prematurely. Confirm concrete API/guard/ownership placement with primary/Astra before implementing.

Acceptance: held accepted gains change nonzero PCM BEFORE Commit in actual verified-streaming native route;0→positive/positive→0/2, audio and supported instrument/Session scenarios. Canonical state/history/dirty unchanged through Begin/Changes; final absolute Commit once/oneUndo, unchangedvalue no fakeUndo, Cancel restores latest canonical including intervening independentedit. Coalescing/queuepressure/finalvalue/stale generation/late preview after commit-cancel/delete/reorder/newautomation/recording exclusion preserve lastvalid audio and actual source/media ownership. Existing source-reservation/file-invalid/cancel/refusal behavior preserved. Runtime state/time continuity, callback total/net allocation-free probe and finite optimized input-to-audio-applied/backlog/terminal observations with exact source, no unmeasured native/listening claims.

Resident331 implementation proceeds independently; this linked acceptance remains required for full applicable-mode volume workflow, not optional silent de-scope. Current stage todo for concrete source-interface design, not implementation/merge/delivery readiness. Source1 is the likely continuation after its resident checkpoint, but any authenticated contributor may help within explicit disjoint boundaries. Dedicated merger owns canonical PR integration/exact final localCI/merge; root owns sole Mac/native optimized delivery. No hostedCI, app/backend/install/launch/quit/unlock/permission/userdata actions authorized by this planning entry. Alpha legacy migration/backwards compatibility out of scope; current user data preserved.
